name: Remove a key from a keyring
description: Remove a held key or phrase. The venue signs nothing new with it; tokens and signatures it already made stay valid.

operation.activityLabel: Remove a key from a keyring

key.description: A held key: its did:key, multibase public key or 0x account key in your keyring, or <did>/x/crypto/keys/<key> in another holder's. Give this or mnemonic.

mnemonic.description: A held phrase: its ID in your keyring, or <did>/x/crypto/mnemonics/<id> in another holder's. Give this or key.
